sql.if: AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP(DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 540 MINUTE)) - INTERVAL (#{days} - 1) DAY - INTERVAL (540 - TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), NOW())) MINUTE

mapper.sql: DATE(created_at + INTERVAL (540 - TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, UTC_TIMESTAMP(), NOW())) MINUTE)
session_hash, age_band, dong, household_types, income_rank, disability, nationality, edu_work
mapper.select: WITH m AS ( /* 결과 화면까지 본 세션 */ SELECT DISTINCT session_hash FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ), e AS ( /* 세션별로 상세(D)·신청 안내(A)를 했는지 */ SELECT session_hash, MAX(event = 'D' AND resource_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_d, MAX(event = 'A') AS has_a FROM event_log WHERE 1 = 1 GROUP BY session_hash ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ) s) AS searches, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m) AS matched_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m JOIN e ON e.session_hash = m.session_hash WHERE e.has_d = 1) AS viewed_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM m JOIN e ON e.session_hash = m.session_hash WHERE e.has_d = 1 AND e.has_a = 1) AS applied_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM e WHERE e.has_d = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m WHERE m.session_hash = e.session_hash)) AS browse_only_sessions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_log WHERE event = 'D' AND resource_id IS NOT NULL ) AS detail_views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_log WHERE event = 'A' ) AS apply_clicks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM event_log WHERE event = 'R' ) AS reports, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(result_count)) FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ) AS avg_results, (SELECT MIN(result_count) FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ) AS min_results, (SELECT MAX(result_count) FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ) AS max_results

SELECT e.resource_id, r.name, r.org_name, r.category, r.status, e.views, e.applies FROM (SELECT resource_id, SUM(event = 'D') AS views, SUM(event = 'A') AS applies FROM event_log WHERE resource_id IS NOT NULL AND event IN ('D', 'A') GROUP BY resource_id) e LEFT JOIN resource r ON r.resource_id = e.resource_id ORDER BY e.views DESC, e.applies DESC, e.resource_id LIMIT 10

WITH s AS ( SELECT DISTINCT FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ) SELECT 'AGE' AS dim, age_band AS code, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM s GROUP BY age_band UNION ALL SELECT 'DONG', dong, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY dong UNION ALL SELECT 'HH', household_types, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY household_types UNION ALL SELECT 'INCOME', CASE income_rank WHEN 1 THEN '1' WHEN 2 THEN '2' WHEN 3 THEN '3' WHEN 4 THEN '4' END, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY income_rank UNION ALL SELECT 'DIS', disability, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY disability UNION ALL SELECT 'NAT', nationality, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY nationality UNION ALL SELECT 'EDU', edu_work, COUNT(*) FROM s GROUP BY edu_work

SELECT log_day, SUM(searches) AS searches, SUM(views) AS views, SUM(applies) AS applies, SUM(reports) AS reports FROM (SELECT log_day, COUNT(*) AS searches, 0 AS views, 0 AS applies, 0 AS reports FROM (SELECT DISTINCT AS log_day, FROM match_log WHERE 1 = 1 ) ms GROUP BY log_day UNION ALL SELECT AS log_day, 0, SUM(event = 'D' AND resource_id IS NOT NULL), SUM(event = 'A'), SUM(event = 'R') FROM event_log WHERE event IN ('D', 'A', 'R') GROUP BY log_day) t GROUP BY log_day ORDER BY log_day DESC LIMIT 31
